descriptions.adaptable: Flexibly responds to changing circumstances and requirements
descriptions.artisan: Creates beautiful and high-quality work in any medium
descriptions.coder: Skilled in programming languages and development
descriptions.communicator: Clear and effective in expressing ideas and listening to others
descriptions.dataWhiz: Excels at analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing data
descriptions.decisionMaker: Makes timely, thoughtful choices that move projects forward
descriptions.delegator: Effectively distributes responsibilities based on team strengths

descriptions.detailOriented: Notices and addresses small details others might miss
descriptions.documentationMaster: Creates clear, thorough, and helpful documentation
descriptions.empathetic: Understands others perspectives and emotional needs
descriptions.feedbackProvider: Offers constructive criticism that helps others improve
descriptions.initiativeTaker: Proactively identifies opportunities and takes action
descriptions.innovator: Consistently brings fresh ideas and novel approaches
descriptions.knowledgeSharer: Generously shares expertise and helps others learn
descriptions.mediator: Helps resolve conflicts and find middle ground between different opinions
descriptions.mentor: Helps others develop their skills through guidance and support
descriptions.motivator: Inspires others and maintains positive energy within the team
descriptions.organizer: Keeps projects structured, manages timelines, and coordinates efforts
descriptions.persistent: Overcomes obstacles with determination and resilience
descriptions.problemSolver: Finds creative solutions to challenging situations
descriptions.quickLearner: Rapidly adapts to new information and technologies
descriptions.reliable: Consistently delivers on commitments and meets deadlines
descriptions.storyteller: Communicates ideas effectively through compelling narratives
descriptions.strategicPlanner: Develops comprehensive, long-term approaches to achieving goals
descriptions.systemsThinker: Understands complex systems and how components interact
descriptions.teamPlayer: Consistently contributes to team goals and supports fellow members
descriptions.techSupport: Helps troubleshoot and solve technical problems
descriptions.visionary: Sees the big picture and envisions future possibilities

privacy.chatUpload: Files and images shared in chat are visible to conversation participants. Please do not upload sensitive or confidential information.
privacy.location: Location is optional. We use saved location information to suggest nearby users, teams, and roles and to calculate distance-based matches. Lomir does not ask for a street address. Depending on visibility settings, approximate location details may be visible to other users.
privacy.profileVisibilitySettings: Public profiles are visible to anyone visiting Lomir, whether or not they are logged in. Private profiles reduce public visibility, but your activity may still appear in teams, messages, applications, or badges. Location details you add may be shown as part of your approximate public profile location.
privacy.userLocation: Location is optional. You can leave postal code, city, and country empty or remove them later. If you add location information, Lomir uses it to suggest nearby users, teams, and roles and to calculate distance-based matches. Lomir never asks for your street address. Depending on your profile visibility, approximate location details such as postal code, city, district, region, or country may be visible to other users.
